baseline_scenario.name: Current Baseline (Vadgaon Sheri - Ganesh Nagar)
baseline_scenario.notes: Observed OpenCity municipal spatial metrics and current forecast proxies.

heatwave_scenario.name: Extreme Heatwave Shock (+3.5°C Ambient Prolonged)
heatwave_scenario.notes: Simulated persistent high LST exposure in unshaded, high-density residential sectors.

flash_rainfall_scenario.name: Extreme Cloudburst Monsoon Shock (+75mm 3-Hour Downpour)
flash_rainfall_scenario.notes: Simulated stormwater inundation at drainage constriction points and low-elevation junctions.

post_adaptation_scenario.name: Post-Implementation Portfolio Outcome (INR 5,000,000)
post_adaptation_scenario.notes: Modelled estimate reflecting 5 adaptation actions. Notice: Only indicators with defensible physical mechanisms are subtracted. Directional maintenance actions (such as drain desilting) contribute to resilience but do not claim uncalibrated flood probability drops.

heat_exposure_proxy.notes: Driven by cool roof albedo reflectance and pedestrian shade canopy planting.

flood_screening_proxy.notes: Driven by retention basins and soakaways. Drain desilting provides directional maintenance, but does not alter hydraulic 100-yr flood probability.

water_stress_proxy.notes: Driven by decentralized institutional rainwater harvesting.

green_deficit_proxy.notes: Driven by native roadside shade corridors and vegetated bioretention swales.

composite_vulnerability_score.notes: Recomputed strictly from updated constituent proxies using standard Pune weights (0.35 Heat + 0.35 Flood + 0.15 Water + 0.15 Green).

directional_interventions.title: Shaded Bus Stops & Public Cooling Kiosks with Drinking Water
directional_interventions.notes: Cooling kiosks provide acute localized commuter relief; numerical effect on macro ward-level surface temperature is physically negligible and unavailable.

directional_interventions.title: Critical Stormwater Drain Desilting & Inlet Trash Screens
directional_interventions.notes: Desilting restores baseline designed pipe conveyance. However, it does not enlarge pipe capacity or provide a defensible numerical reduction in extreme storm flood probability.

data_provenance_and_limitations: Tree and green space counts from OpenStreetMap are crowd-sourced and incomplete; not equivalent to satellite canopy cover.
Temperature forecasts are city-level from Open-Meteo, not localized ward-level telemetry.
Stormwater drainage coverage is an infrastructure proxy, not a calibrated 2D hydraulic inundation model.
Participatory budget figures reflect municipal allocations, not direct well groundwater table sensors.
Census population data is 2011 baseline; ward demographics have shifted significantly since.
